cards.note: Host/session-log plane: the plugin owns its JSON usage store and node:sqlite credential store and never reads Session logs.
Cross-version session resume is a SessionHandle/session-log behavior the plugin does not use.
No native module, no install script (node:sqlite is built in); fs-ext never enters this package tree.
Outbound supplier/adapter traffic uses global fetch and constructs no bare undici dispatcher, so the host-installed proxy policy applies unchanged.
The plugin never calls or implements agentLoop/session persistence; it only registers webServer routes and an llm adapter.
Session log v2 and the migration catalog are read surfaces the plugin does not touch.
Unpublished-cohort recipe; the migration target 0.1.5-rc.1 is a published npm release, and the plugin installs through dsh plugin add.
The client half renders only its settings page; it registers no conversation.input.* seat and no tool-card renderer.
The bundle patch inserts the plugin's own row only; it configures no persona text/persona keys.
No subprocess seam usage: the plugin spawns nothing and never touches SubprocessHandle.
The composition mounts no tool rows of its own and does not depend on the shipped base tool set.
No CLI launcher, bin, or headless wrapper in this package.
No direct @earendil-works/pi-ai dependency anywhere in the manifest or lockfile.
Session log V3 concerns stored Session logs; the plugin has no session-log reader and writes no session events.
ctx.agent is never read (host half takes ctx.baseUrl/logger/webServer/llm only); no AgentSetup implementation.
The Inbox runtime class and agent.inbox are not imported or constructed.
The plugin appends/seeds no session events (surfaceOp, SurfaceIntent, headers); usage tracking is a side-band JSON store.
No PTC/code-mode event filters, dashboards or log readers; the adapter only maps OpenAI SSE to StreamChunk.
Imports only the TokenUsage type from dsh-llm and computes no token-meter/contextBreakdown projection.
Adapter forwards both options.system (one-shot) and in-history system messages (0.1.5 loop-built requests); wire test locks the new path.
No scoped Remote event forwarding and no custom Remote implementation.
Docs and install instructions use the web profile only; the desktop profile name is never passed.
The plugin ships a bundle, not a profile; README already installs via dsh plugin --profile web add (which creates the profile).
No workspaceFiles/readByteRange usage; the plugin serves its own /v1 and /router/api JSON routes.
Goals are neither observed nor read; no goal/activation-changed subscription.
No native dependency or native build step; packaging is plain ESM plus a Vite client bundle.
Registers only settings.section; no details-panel slot, openDetails/closeDetails call, or tool-detail seat.
No slash commands, composer bar, prompt inspector, chat node, or deliverables turn-tail surface.
Optional right-column/resource seats: the plugin adds no right-sidebar tab or resource provider.
No openFile implementation or call site; file links are not part of the panel.
The composition mounts only the plugin row; tool-subagent and modelSelectionSettings are not used.
No directory-picker, SSH/detection, or instruction-discovery calls anywhere in the plugin or its tests.
Client-plugin fleet on upgraded profiles: README install section now documents the attribute-first rule (new 404 vs old 200) and the one-restart self-heal.
No workspaceFiles injection or call; the plugin's file access is its own profile-anchored JSON/sqlite stores.
The plugin never serves workspace file content, so the read-confinement/maxFileBytes change does not reach it.
No conversation/main/sidebar.panellist registration. The legacy DOM sidebar+center-column mount is a pre-slots fallback and is unreachable once slots exist (client entry injects slots).
The composition does not use the minimal preset and mounts no filesystem tool rows.
No stored Session log is read or written, so the new non-ignorable events cannot make a plugin read fail.
No dsh-llm-pi-ai dependency; the plugin registers its own LlmAdapter for the router provider.
The adapter transports the host-provided prompt but contributes no tool-guidance sections.
Optional delivery/reveal surface: the plugin produces no files or deliverables.
No dependency on ui-sidebar-textpreview or its renamed successor.
Optional packaging: the panel renders a bounded recent-requests list (500-entry store cap); no hand-rolled large-list virtualization to retire.
The plugin connects no MCP servers and inspects no MCP tool-list cursors.
Informational format-status card; the plugin writes no Session log.
No rightbar occupancy and no layout service/store reads; the panel lives in the settings dialog.
No dsh-client-resources dependency, useResource call, or ResourceProvider implementation.
The client half imports no ui-primitives icon/file-type helpers; icons are inline SVG and CSS masks.
No ui-dockkit embedding or adapter.
No message-feedback service call or injected surface registration.
No uiWorkspace injection; the panel drives no session/workspace navigation.
No chatFileMentions implementation/call and no turn-tail produced-files read.
Browser-only tooling (vite, css-injected-by-js) stays in devDependencies; runtime modules come from dsh.client.inject peers, and the package declares no runtime dependencies.
Optional documentPreviews registry: the plugin renders no document previews and registers no sidebar.right.tab.document.
Optional command UI: the plugin registers no command decorations or slash commands.
No dsh-command-feedback dependency and no feedback recording.
No right-sidebar tab types or guide entries registered, so the description/lazy-seed changes do not reach it.
The bundle patch sets no agent model id (it only inserts the plugin row); deepseek-* names in tests are upstream supplier model fixtures, not the harness default.
The plugin is a model-discovery provider (combos) and reads the catalog through the llm service; it hardcodes no built-in adapter list.
No sidebar.right.tab.document renderer registered, so scrollportRef is not consumed.
Optional guide-entry description: the plugin registers no sidebar.right.tab.* type.
Informational negative evidence for the alpha.2 to rc.1 edge; no plugin-facing surface beyond the carded ones moved, and the plugin's own migration is covered by the cards above.
